newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas Arapua maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas Arapua maintained.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian retailer Lojas Arapua.
-- "We are reaffirming our buy recommendation for Lojas Arapua due to its good results so far and promising prospects," the brokerage stated in a report.
-- Fator said Arapua plans to open 30 new stores next year, which will help increasing the company's revenues by 40 percent.
-- Lojas Arapua was not traded on the Sao Paulo bourse on Wednesday.
